title: Rabbi Berechyah, son of Rabbi Chelbo
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah ch. 3, par. 7, where he spoke in the name of Abba Samokid, and in Vayikra Rabbah ch. 36, par. 6, where he spoke in the name of Rava bar Zavda; and it appears that the text should read: Rabbi Berekhya in the name of Rabbi Helbo.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman tentatively replaces a father-name reading with a report in Rabbi Chelbo’s name.

The complete named discourse in Numbers Rabbah 3:7 names Rabbi Berekhyah ben Rabbi Chelbo in Abba Smokyad’s name. Vayikra Rabbah 36:6 has Berekhyah bar Chelbo in Rava bar Zavda’s name. Hyman’s tentative “it appears that the text should read” transmission through Chelbo is preserved as a proposed correction, not a genealogy or teacher admission.
